display.purpose: Hero name and title-card scale only.

body.purpose: Short proof-oriented paragraphs capped around 50 to 55ch.

shadows.name: inset-bezel-highlight
shadows.purpose: Subtle machined lip inside bezel containers.

motion.name: reveal-standard
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 40px to 0, blur(8px) to blur(0px), duration 0.8s

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA pill used for project viewing and contact routing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--text-primary, #f5f5f5); color: var(--bg, #050505); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #c9a96e); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a96e); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary-icon { transform: translate(4px, -1px); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Low-pressure secondary action with a quiet underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-text-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; padding: 0.75rem 0; color: var(--text-secondary, #a3a3a3); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms ease; } .ds-text-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0.5rem; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--accent, #c9a96e); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #f5f5f5); } .ds-text-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a96e); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Chip
components.description: Section marker with mono precision and gold signal.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-block; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--accent, #c9a96e); font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Tech Tag
components.description: Small proof label for project stacks and competency levels.
components.css: .ds-tech-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--text-muted, #525252); font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; }

components.name: Double Bezel Card
components.description: Primary evidence container for projects, skills, and contact methods.
components.html:
Meridian Auth

Enterprise-grade identity provider with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML support.
components.css: .ds-bezel-outer { background: var(--card-outer, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 2px; } .ds-bezel-inner { min-height: 12rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2rem; border-radius: calc(1.5rem - 2px); background: var(--card-inner, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); transition: background-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-bezel-outer:hover .ds-bezel-inner { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-bezel-inner h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--text-primary, #f5f5f5); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.025em; transition: color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-bezel-outer:hover h3 { color: var(--accent, #c9a96e); } .ds-bezel-inner p { max-width: 50ch; margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary, #a3a3a3); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; }

components.css: .ds-contact-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)); border-radius: 1.5rem; background: var(--card-inner, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: var(--text-primary, #f5f5f5); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-contact-row:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); } .ds-contact-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent-dim, rgba(201, 169, 110, 0.15)); color: var(--accent, #c9a96e); } .ds-contact-row small { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.125rem; color: var(--text-muted, #525252); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-contact-row strong { display: block; color: var(--text-primary, #f5f5f5); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-contact-row b { color: var(--text-muted, #525252); font-weight: 400; transition: color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-contact-row:hover b { color: var(--accent, #c9a96e); transform: translate(4px, -1px); } .ds-contact-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a96e); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This system feels like a private technical screening room: dark, quiet, precise, and built for fast judgment. Recruiters and clients should land in a controlled atmosphere where proof, trust, and next actions are easy to read. The visual mood is cinematic without theatrics: near-black surfaces, hairline structure, restrained gold signal, and slow reveals that feel deliberate rather than decorative.

The portfolio is a brand surface, but the brand is competence under pressure. It rejects generic SaaS-template aesthetics, decorative gradients, gimmicky motion, and bloated claim sections. Every visual decision must support the Product principle: Show proof, not claims.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, tinted-black environment with warm-white text and muted ash hierarchy.
One rare signal color, burnished gold, used for trust cues, hover states, and selected attention.
Double-bezel containers with hairline borders instead of heavy cards.
Large, tight, confident type set in Geist, supported by compact Geist Mono labels.
Motion is slow, directional, and purposeful; it reveals hierarchy instead of performing.

rules.name: The Gold Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Gold is a signal, not a theme. If more than one small cluster per viewport is gold, the page starts lying about importance.

rules.name: The No Decorative Gradient Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric glow may exist as scene lighting. Loud, decorative gradients used without semantic purpose are prohibited.

rules.name: The Not-Quite-Black Rule
rules.body: Never use pure #000 or pure #fff. This system depends on softened blacks and warm whites.

rules.name: The Title Card Rule
rules.body: Display type is allowed to be large and quiet at the same time. Do not add gradients, outlines, shadows, or gimmicks to make it feel designed.

rules.name: The Mono Rationing Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for metadata and control surfaces only. Do not turn body copy into faux-terminal text.

rules.name: The No Floating Cards Rule
rules.body: Cards do not float with generic shadows. They sit inside double bezels and separate through borders, tone, and inset highlights.

rules.name: The State-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces stay flat. Interaction may brighten the inner surface or move an arrow, but it must not create fake depth theatrics.

dos: Do use Near Black as the primary environment and Warm White Text for the strongest information.
Do keep Signal Gold rare, precise, and attached to action or proof.
Do use the double-bezel card pattern for project, competency, and contact evidence.
Do keep body copy under roughly 55ch and make each paragraph prove capability or clarify next action.
Do keep motion slow, directional, and purposeful with cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1).
Do preserve the direct path to DM and GitHub when adding sections or changing hierarchy.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS-template aesthetics that feel interchangeable.
Don't use loud, decorative gradients without semantic purpose.
Don't add gimmicky motion that prioritizes spectacle over clarity.
Don't add bloated sections that restate claims without proof.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as default, side-stripe borders, or hero-metric templates.
Don't turn the system into terminal cosplay with excessive monospace, neon accents, or fake command-line panels.
Don't add identical card grids with icon, heading, and text repeated endlessly.
Don't animate width, height, padding, or margin. Underlines and directional cues must use transform-based motion.
